statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The denial reason code is CO-97
The patient has recurrent palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent lightheadedness
The symptoms are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture the arrhythmic burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
Payment for this service is not reimbursable as a standalone item when performed in conjunction with the primary diagnostic evaluation
